propositions: The eval/calibration library excludes activated project code-review criteria from admission; _code_review_prompt_id only admits static built-in ids without repository context.
calibrate_criterion maps non-physical ids through plan-review namespace exclusively and lacks code-review membership branching.
_code_review_prompt_id must accept repo_root as optional parameter and admit logical ids from code_review.registry.effective_criteria() mapped via criterion_prompt_id(gate_key='code_review').
calibrate_criterion must conditionally route to code-review arm when repo_root is not None and criterion_id is active in the repository; otherwise preserve plan-review behavior unchanged.
EvalError from load_eval_spec in the code-review arm must be re-raised with located error including the logical criterion_id.
Backward compatibility requires _code_review_prompt_id to admit built-in ids without repo_root and plan-review criteria to follow unchanged path even with non-None repo_root.
